from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,time
q=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
arguments=sys.argv[1:]
identity=f'{time.time_ns()}-{os.getpid()}'
started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
record={'id':identity,'arguments':arguments,'start_utc':started,'cwd':str(Path.cwd()),'official_wrapper':str(Path.cwd()/'gradlew-original')}
record['official_wrapper_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(Path('gradlew-original').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for index,argument in enumerate(arguments):
 if argument=='--init-script':
  path=Path(arguments[index+1]); content=path.read_bytes(); digest=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
  saved=q/f'native-sync-export-{identity}.gradle'; saved.write_bytes(content)
  record.update({'init_path':str(path),'saved_init_path':str(saved),'init_sha256':digest,'expected_source_bridge_sha256':'508ecc9987932f8d184983f551eca0cb1bc9efa6ed12806dcaff8a0a2f6880b7','matches_source':digest=='508ecc9987932f8d184983f551eca0cb1bc9efa6ed12806dcaff8a0a2f6880b7'})
(q/f'gradle-start-{identity}.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
process=subprocess.Popen(['/bin/sh','./gradlew-original',*arguments],stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
with (q/f'native-sync-stdout-{identity}.log').open('xb') as individual,(q/'native-sync-stdout.log').open('ab') as combined:
 while True:
  data=process.stdout.read1(8192)
  if not data: break
  individual.write(data); individual.flush(); combined.write(data); combined.flush(); sys.stdout.buffer.write(data); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
 os.fsync(individual.fileno()); os.fsync(combined.fileno())
status=process.wait()
record.update({'finish_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'return_code':status,'raw_stdout_sha256':hashlib.sha256((q/f'native-sync-stdout-{identity}.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
(q/f'gradle-finish-{identity}.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
sys.exit(status if status>=0 else 128-status)
